bounded_assessment.90_contact_keys: Contacts cluster in seven named 2006 JOR features and four specific foreign features; official primary sources reviewed establish useful hierarchy, chronology, and boundary context for Ayy, Wadi Araba, and Al-Azraq. They do not adjudicate the exact center contacts. Keep each original contact and conflict held; full JOR same-member hits do not cancel foreign simplified intersections.
bounded_assessment.decision: Keep all 93 held as exact key-bound source-applicability conflicts. This is a finite conflict disposition grounded in measured simplified-product native hits and recorded original contract, enriched with official hierarchy/history context; it is not a finding of foreign sovereignty, current legal boundary, unresolved ownership, or exhaustive research. No single universal legal/crosswalk prerequisite is imposed.
bounded_assessment.physical_and_native: Existing physical-002 per-center checks show no exact center hits on target-specific issue/context geometries for the 90, and all three misses are mapped-land support with no same-target issue/context hit. These are narrow per-center results, not whole-cell, territorial, or legal clearance.
